description: In front of you on the bed are a small light-purple bowl, a white LEGO-like block, a green block with a toy croissant on it, and a pink round slice toy with a small white cube nearby. The left hand reaches forward to the white LEGO-like block, pinches and lifts it, then moves it rightward over the bowl and lowers it inside before releasing; the right hand hovers near the pink slice without touching anything.
